correctness.rationale: Stereographic factors cancel and Y is a signed sum of four centered log half-chord distances. A single squared half-chord is Uniform(0,1), giving E[X]=0, E[X²]=1/4, E[X⁴]=9/16. Any proper subset of the four cycle edges is a forest: leaf integration against rotationally invariant vertices makes each triple independent. The centered log-chord kernel K is Hilbert-Schmidt with spherical-harmonic eigenvalue -1/(2l(l+1)) for l>=1 and multiplicity 2l+1 from Funk-Hecke/Legendre integration. Thus the nonzero mixed four-edge moment is trace T^4=sum (2l+1)/(16l^4(l+1)^4)=5/16-zeta(3)/4; rational partial fractions and fourth-power multinomial expansion give E[Y⁴]=12-6*zeta(3), variance1. Independently recomputed partial fractions and high-precision ζ3 values. Validity depends on uniform spherical S2 samples and the specified cross-ratio pairing, not four circle points.
